info.name: Denim Public API Reference Documentation Companies Transactions API

params.name: query
params.description: Search by company name, amount, reference, or description

params.name: start_date
params.description: Filter transactions after date in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: end_date
params.description: Filter transactions before date in YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: transaction_owner
params.description: Enum type to help filter payments by who made them. One of [all, payee, debtor, client].

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to query.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of entities per page of results.

items.docs: Transactions are payments incoming, outgoing, netting, and adjustments. Transactions are are generally applied towards obligations.
